critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - SeoLocalPage.jsx was refactored from 390 lines to ~185 lines with 8 modular components
All components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Fallback behavior works correctly when hero_image is not set (uses Unsplash fallback)
WebP conversion in backend uses Pillow correctly with quality=80 and max width 1200px
seed_data_creation: 7 SEO pages seeded automatically on startup from /app/backend/services/seo_seed.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO local pages UI/UX redesign fully tested. New components: SeoHero, SeoSection, SeoCtaBlock, SeoSteps, SeoTrustStats, SeoVehicleGallery, SeoFaq, SeoNearbyCities. All located in /app/frontend/src/components/seo/. Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/seo-upload converts images to WebP. New MongoDB fields: hero_image, city_image, section_images, gallery_vehicles. Existing seeded pages don't have these fields populated (fallback behavior tested). Admin SeoTab includes SeoImageUpload components for all image fields.
